title: DEFVERIFY: Do Hate Speech Models Reflect Their Dataset’s Definition?

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating trained hate speech models on an enriched HateCheck diagnostic set to measure classification accuracy, false positives, and false negatives for statements targeting racial groups, including testing for the erroneous flagging of dominant groups (e.g., white people) as a proxy for unintended model bias.

Evaluating trained hate speech models on an enriched HateCheck diagnostic set to measure classification accuracy, false positives, and false negatives for statements targeting gender groups, including testing for the erroneous flagging of dominant groups (e.g., men) to identify dataset-to-model misalignment.

Assessing model performance and definition alignment using the HateCheck diagnostic set by checking the model's capability to correctly identify hate speech and non-hate speech directed at various religious groups.
Assessing model performance and definition alignment using the HateCheck diagnostic set by checking the model's capability to correctly classify statements targeting different sexual orientations.
Assessing model performance and definition alignment using the HateCheck diagnostic set to measure how accurately models classify statements targeting nationalities and immigrant populations.
Assessing model performance and definition alignment using the HateCheck diagnostic set to measure how accurately models classify statements targeting people with disabilities.
